run_gtest_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_behavior: test that passing --help, -h, -?, or /? prints the help message and exits with code 0
test_non_help_flag_behavior: test that passing no help flag runs the actual tests and does not print the help message
test_incorrect_flag_variants: test that incorrect flag styles like single dash or forward slash still trigger help output
test_internal_flag_behavior: test that flags prefixed with gtest_internal_ run tests without printing the help message
